platforms.name: Freelance.ru
platforms.note: RSS /rss/projects.xml often 404. Feed: HTML https://freelance.ru/task via PROXY_1 RU SOCKS5 (no direct).

platforms.name: Kwork
platforms.note: PROXY_1 as default socks; offer via browser. Adapter module downloaded on first use.

platforms.name: HH.ru
platforms.note: Official API: GET /vacancies (app UA+token); apply POST negotiations needs applicant OAuth. MCP: search only (include_jobs); no apply tool yet. Without registered app → 403. remote+project/part filters in adapter.

platforms.name: Remotive
platforms.note: public JSON API; default category software-dev; REMOTIVE_CATEGORY optional

platforms.name: Arbeitnow
platforms.note: free job-board API; default remoteOnly; ARBEITNOW_REMOTE_ONLY=0 for all

platforms.name: Adzuna
platforms.note: ADZUNA_APP_ID + ADZUNA_APP_KEY; ADZUNA_COUNTRY=gb; ADZUNA_WHAT optional

platforms.name: Himalayas
platforms.note: Public JSON /jobs/api + RSS; apply → employer ATS. Credit Himalayas per their ToS.

platforms.name: We Work Remotely
platforms.note: Public category RSS; default WWR_CATEGORY=programming; apply → employer

platforms.name: Jobicy
platforms.note: Public API v2; default JOBICY_TAG=dev; credit Jobicy + link to original URL

platforms.name: Dream Offer
platforms.note: Search via GET /initial-dataset (+ vacancy.html SSR scan). No native apply API — open source_link (TG/LinkedIn/ATS) after user ok. Env: DREAMOFFER_PROFESSION=Mobile, DREAMOFFER_WORK_FORMAT=remote, DREAMOFFER_LANG=ru, DREAMOFFER_SCAN_EXTRA=40

platforms.name: Working Nomads
platforms.note: Public GET /api/exposed_jobs/; WORKING_NOMADS_CATEGORY optional filter

platforms.name: The Muse
platforms.note: Public /api/public/jobs; THEMUSE_CATEGORY optional; apply → employer

platforms.name: 4 Day Week
platforms.note: Public /api/jobs; FOUR_DAY_WEEK_REMOTE_ONLY=1 to keep remote-only

platforms.name: AI Dev Jobs
platforms.note: REST /api/v1/jobs + OpenAPI + MCP; default workplace=remote; AIDEV_API_KEY optional

platforms.name: Aquent
platforms.note: Public feeds/jobs.xml; default AQUENT_REMOTE_ONLY; credit Aquent; MCP at jobs.mcp.skill.com

platforms.name: Growth.Talent
platforms.note: Public GET /api/v1/jobs; apply needs gt_live_… key. GROWTH_TALENT_REMOTE=1 / GROWTH_TALENT_Q optional

platforms.name: Claw Earn
platforms.note: GET /claw/tasks?tab=available (not /api/claw/*); USDC Base escrow; CLAW_EARN_TAB optional; feed often sparse

platforms.name: SeekClaw
platforms.note: GET /api/jobs; Ed25519 agent auth for apply; open listings often empty

platforms.name: Superteam Earn
platforms.note: SUPERTEAM_EARN_API_KEY from POST https://superteam.fun/api/agents; listings at /api/agents/listings/live; human claim for payout

platforms.name: RentAHuman
platforms.note: Reverse market: agents hire humans. Public GET /api/bounties; writes need x-api-key

platforms.name: Openwork
platforms.note: Crew Economy on Base; GET /api/missions; OPENWORK_OPEN_ONLY=0 to include claimed/verified. ≠ dealwork.ai

platforms.name: Profi.ru
platforms.note: partner mTLS out of scope; browser: cabinet orders → capture get_job → apply

platforms.name: Avito Услуги
platforms.note: ToS: semi-manual only; chat / отклик на услуги

platforms.name: YouDo
platforms.note: Browser: tasks for doers → capture → reply

platforms.name: SproutGigs
platforms.note: Microtasks / gigs; login → Jobs → apply in browser

platforms.name: Product Radar
platforms.note: HTML feed: /category/hiring/?page=N (article.products__item + card__status-text). Core fetch into store → workix_search/digest. Prefer direct (PROXY_1 SOCKS may hang). Apply: product page / TG — browser.

platforms.name: StartupFellows
platforms.note: Watch only: vacancies at /vacancies. Not in workix_search store. Capture lead: workix_get_job(url+platform+title) → draft → browser/TG apply.

platforms.name: YC Co-Founder Matching
platforms.note: Watch only: approved YC matching profile required. No public job feed for digest. Semi-manual invites only.

platforms.name: Fiverr
platforms.note: No public API / no job board. Buyer Requests retired → Briefs (inbound match). Gates: seller onboarding + ≥1 gig + Get Briefs; phone verify (required for freelancers/Gig create); ID + personal/business verify via Persona (dashboard: not visible until done — may be required for Catalog). US: Form W-9. Apply = Create Offer / Custom Offer in browser. Cookies not in env.

platforms.name: Wellfound
platforms.note: Watch only: login + browser on /jobs. No public API for Workix digest. Capture via get_job then prepare_browser_apply.

platforms.name: BotPool
platforms.note: AI/bots freelance; ~10% fee

platforms.name: Habr Career
platforms.note: Remote vacancies RSS in include_jobs; watch URL for manual UI

platforms.name: LinkedIn Jobs / topics
platforms.note: ToS: полуручной только; #hiring #cofounder

platforms.name: Telegram channels (TDLib optional)
platforms.note: BYO: TELEGRAM_API_ID/HASH + npm i tdl prebuilt-tdlib; tools workix_tg_*; list mcp/telegram-channels.json

platforms.name: Feltsense
platforms.note: не маркетплейс — agentic founders / careers

platforms.name: Magier
platforms.note: design network; не открытая биржа

platforms.name: Upwork
platforms.note: P0: VPN/mobile EN. GraphQL search; proposal API or browser. Adapter module downloaded on first use.

platforms.name: Freelancer.com
platforms.note: P0: VPN/WireGuard. FREELANCER_OAUTH_TOKEN; adapter module downloaded on first use.

platforms.name: dStore
platforms.note: Built into Workix MCP: publish ready PWA/website with workix_dstore_publish. Also search/similar/get/list/quota. Complements Workix hub (people/roles).

platforms.name: Indeed
platforms.note: Reached through the optional JobSpy bridge: pip install -U python-jobspy, Python 3.10-3.12 (it pins numpy 1.26.3, which does not build on 3.13 — use a venv and set PYTHON_BIN). The board forbids automated collection in its terms; you install this module and run it on your own responsibility. Board credentials ship inside the jobspy release — keep it upgraded.
